name: asdr
description: AI Software Delivery Room — 19-agent SDLC harness with independent QA, end-to-end journey checks, live browser tests and user manuals, plus the companion plugins it uses (UI UX Pro Max, Ponytail).

plugins.name: ai-software-delivery-room
plugins.description: Start where you choose: ASDR recommends the start point and converts your own documents. Idea validation → brief → flows → architecture → sprints with contract-first builds, live browser tests and evaluator-only sign-off. Architecture, cloud and which decisions become settings are yours to decide, with costs. A per-role model plan (economy / balanced / maximum). Dashboards, client reports; assesses existing systems. Exports to Codex and Gemini CLIs. Installs UI UX Pro Max.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Offline design-system generator (styles, palettes with contrast pairs, font pairings, checklist). Used by ASDR's design-system stage. Upstream: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill, MIT.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: YAGNI ladder via hooks. OPTIONAL: ASDR's generator already carries the ladder (templates/build-ladder.md). Install only if you want it outside ASDR, and set PONYTAIL_SUBAGENT_MATCHER='^generator$' (docs/COMPANIONS.md). Upstream: DietrichGebert/ponytail, MIT.
